indications.description: Locally advanced or metastatic head and neck cancer.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cisplatin 25 mg/m² daily on days 1–4, each over 2 hours, followed by fluorouracil 1000 mg/m²/day over 22 hours on each of days 1–4; repeat every 28 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

eligibility: Locally advanced or metastatic head and neck cancer; ECOG 0–2.
Baseline ANC > 1.5 ×10⁹/L; the source prints platelets 100 ×10⁹/L without an inequality, requiring clarification at the exact boundary.
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × ULN, transaminases ≤ 5 × ULN and bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to cisplatin, fluorouracil or excipients; pregnancy or lactation.
Baseline peripheral neuropathy grade ≥ 2; severe hepatic impairment; baseline CrCl < 60 mL/min; significant hearing impairment/tinnitus.
